notes: All nine measured zones stay separable in the render. The residual is a global value offset, not a hue error: the shell renders about two thirds of a stop below the reference's #E6E7F2, which is what drives the tier-1 per-part delta-E failure.
Transmission 0.30 with flat facets keeps the gem reading as a crystal rather than a painted shape.
Facet value steps are baked into vertex colour in three flat bands, so they stay hard-edged at any lighting setting. No normal or displacement map anywhere.
Shell and gem both use transmission and therefore three's transmissive pass, which sorts after opaque; the inset layers are additionally spaced in Z so no ordering is left to the sorter alone.
